diagnostics: The first typecheck caught seven missing explicit vi imports; corrected before browser acceptance.
The original stale-type-scope probe used a broad include that became valid when migration completed; it now actually removes a required spec and fails at the intended validator boundary.

The 278-case selection passed but exposed an empty test router receiving a successful closeout navigation. An explicit resolved navigation double plus an exact destination assertion fixes that fixture gap. Only its eight-case file was rerun, passing without the route diagnostic.
teardown: TestBed fixtures are destroyed before clock restoration; native focus/scroll/emitter spies retain Jasmine stub semantics explicitly. Mocks/descriptors, actor selection and only test-owned download anchors are restored/removed in failure-safe afterEach hooks.
omitted: Full 71-file/888-case single-runner execution and native-editor/E2E/preview/lifecycle integration are Phase 5.
Previously converted specs outside the seven named affected consumers were not rerun.
No app builds, install/audit refresh, API/database, site/setup or Linux lifecycle runs for spec-only edits.
scope: No production source, dependency, scheduling provider, budget, SQL history, advisory deadline, CI trigger or release identity changes. Legacy runner/targets/dependencies remain for Phase 5 removal.
